author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Southern New Hampshire’s September 10–13 calendar includes community festivals, museum programming, live music, food events and artisan markets across Manchester, Nashua, Concord and several surrounding towns.

Manchester’s Latino Vibe Festival is scheduled for Saturday from noon to 9 p.m. at Veterans Memorial Park, with live bands and free admission. The Currier Museum of Art will hold Community Day from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., pairing its Radical Quiet exhibition with activities involving the Society for the Protection of New Hampshire Forests and opportunities to meet featured artists.

Other Saturday options include the Wags to Whiskers Festival at Holman Stadium in Nashua, Arts in the Park at Rollins Park in Concord and the Wicked Wine & Brewfest in Litchfield. Multi-day events include Nashua’s Egyptian Food Festival, Manchester’s St. Pius X Parish Fair and the River Valley Artisans Art & Wine Festival in Westmoreland.

The lineup begins Thursday with smaller library, skating and live-music programs and continues through Sunday with Cars & Coffee on Capitol in Concord. Organizers and the Manchester Ink Link guide advise visitors to check venue information for admission requirements and last-minute changes before traveling.
dek: A busy September 10–13 calendar includes Manchester’s Latino Vibe Festival, Community Day at the Currier and events from Nashua to Westmoreland.
headline: Southern New Hampshire weekend slate spans festivals, art and live music
